verdict.rationale: Evidence shows HumanLayer's daemon/agent execution can run on a user-controlled host (cloud VM, workstation, private network), but the core control plane is explicitly tied to the hosted app.humanlayer.com service — no docs describe self-hosting that core product. missing for 10: no self-hosted control-plane/server option, no on-prem deployment guide, no Docker/Helm chart or license for running the full stack independently.
